issue.description: Discovered while diagnosing why 0.2.6 (Authentik OAuth fix) was built but deployment.yml still pointed at 0.2.5: k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/ytt-build.yaml's resolve-version step clones github.com/jedarden/ytt (the read-only mirror, not Forgejo origin) and, when VERSION wasn't bumped by the developer, auto-commits+pushes the bump DIRECTLY to GitHub using a GH_TOKEN credential helper. This violates the fleet's Forgejo-primary/GitHub-read-only-mirror model (org CLAUDE.md, Git Hosting section) -- GitHub now has commits Forgejo doesn't, and Forgejo's server-side push-mirror can't cleanly propagate over that divergence on the next Forgejo push (non-fast-forward). Worked around this time by manually syncing Forgejo's VERSION file to match (ytt commit 7c7a435), which risks a mirror-sync failure on Forgejo's next push attempt, not touching data loss. Real fix: either have resolve-version clone/push against git.ardenone.com (Forgejo) instead of GitHub, or don't auto-bump/push in CI at all -- fail the build with a clear message if VERSION wasn't bumped, and require the version bump to happen in the same commit as the code change (matches k8s/CLAUDE.md Rule #8's stated convention already). Also worth checking whether other *-build.yaml WorkflowTemplates share this same clone-from-GitHub + push-to-GitHub pattern (armor-workflowtemplate.yml is cited as the template ytt-build.yaml mirrors).
issue.title: ytt-build.yaml CI writes version-bump commits to GitHub, not Forgejo (breaks mirror model)

issue.description: Declarative infra is done and verified (ytt-63cd2f04): Authentik's ytt OAuth2 provider client_id/secret confirmed matching OpenBao (secret/ardenone-cluster/ytt/oauth), ytt pod running with the synced secret, discovery endpoint live with correct scopes/claims. What's left needs a real login and can't be done by an agent: (1) In Claude, remove the existing ytt custom connector (if present) and re-add it, or just retry the OAuth flow -- this forces a fresh Authentik login instead of reusing a stale Google-era token/session. (2) Confirm the OAuth flow completes without error (watch for 401/invalid_client -- would mean client_id/secret mismatch despite the UI check; watch for invalid_target -- would mean Authentik unexpectedly rejected an RFC 8707 resource param, contradicting the ADR-003 analysis that Claude never sends one). (3) Confirm tool calls succeed (not 403) -- this proves YTT_ALLOWED_SUBJECTS matched the verified email. (4) THE key open question from ADR-003: if the connector adds successfully but tool calls 403 even with a correct allowlist entry, or if ytt selftest --show-sub / the /tmp/ytt_last_sub file comes back empty/wrong after a successful login, that means email/email_verified are NOT landing on the access token (Authentik's default scope mapping may only put them on the ID token). Fix: in ytt/auth.py's build_auth_provider(), add verify_id_token=True to the YttOIDCProvider(...) call -- the comment already there explains why. (5) Once working end-to-end, update ADR-003 in docs/plan/plan.md to record which of the two outcomes actually happened (access token carried the claims vs needed verify_id_token=True) so this isn't left as an open question forever.
issue.notes: SECOND root cause found via live retry: after 0.2.6 fixed the deploy-staleness bug, a real connector login got further but still failed -- 'FastMCP OAuth Error / invalid_request / The request is otherwise malformed'. Traced via Traefik logs on ardenone-cluster: Authentik's own /application/o/authorize/ endpoint rejected the request outright (302 to an error, never reaching login) because it carried resource=https://mcp.ardenone.com/ytt -- exactly the RFC 8707 rejection reference_authentik_oauth_for_mcp (memory) warned about, and which my ADR-003 'ruled out' note got WRONG (trusted a FastMCP source comment claiming Claude never sends resource; logs prove it does). Fixed: forward_resource=False in build_auth_provider() (ytt commit 88be4b8), built as 0.2.7 (ytt-build-manual-k6rjp), deployed (declarative-config 87ce0a7d). Waiting on rollout, then retry again.
issue.title: ytt: verify live Claude connector re-auth against Authentik (ADR-003)
